name: instruction-eval-v1
description: R2-09B held-out EVAL instruction-following/expository specification. New task, not a reuse of R2-08 DEV instruction prompts.

items.prompt: Explain how to plan a small community vegetable garden for 12 households. Organize your answer with clear headings and cover: (1) choosing and preparing the site, (2) dividing plots fairly, (3) a simple watering and maintenance schedule, (4) basic rules for shared tools and compost, and (5) two common mistakes to avoid. Keep the guidance practical and concrete.
